name: Terra State Community College
tuition_note: In-state (Ohio resident) full-time tuition & fees from terra.edu/apply_aid/paying_for_college/tuition_fees/index.php (2025-26): tuition $219/credit + general fee $32/credit = $251/credit; tuition plateaus at 12 credits so full-time = $3,012/semester x 2 = $6,024/yr. Additional per-credit fees (Library/Tech $9, Student Activities $2, Titan Access $32) not included. Housing: lowest published rate at The Landings at Terra Village (1BR double studio) $3,470/semester x 2 = $6,940/yr, all-inclusive rent, room only, 2026-27 rates from terra.edu/life_at_terra_state/living_on_campus/floor_plans_pricing.php.
